facts.fact: 本章是 Erudite 入会第二关：镜子宫迷宫（不是 ch09 那道石基座谜题）。
facts.anchor: And the second labyrinth is made of mirrors.

facts.fact: Cara 当天早上把新人随机分组，带进举行第二关的庭院（浅水池、睡莲）。
facts.anchor: Cara divided them into random groups before ushering them into the courtyard

facts.fact: 三人组 Caleb、Fernando、Quinn 在入口看地图记路：Quinn 用指尖找出路线，Erudite 出身的 Fernando 把它编成口诀，三人各背一段。
facts.anchor: Quinn was the one who found the path with her fingertip

facts.fact: 进迷宫先漆黑全静，Fernando 抓住两人的手，靠触觉带队往前走。
facts.anchor: At first, everything went black and utterly silent. Fernando was undeterred, grabbing both Caleb’s and Quinn’s hands

facts.fact: Caleb 走自己那一段用的时间是另外两人的两倍，但全队走完，而且不是最后一名。
facts.anchor: It takes him twice as long as the other two to get through his section of the maze

facts.fact: 过关奖励是宿舍床位（已有一半被占），Caleb 挑了靠窗那张；每张床自带高柜、书桌和书架。
facts.anchor: He claims one next to the windows so he can look out at the street beyond.

facts.fact: 走廊屏幕播报的新闻里有 factionless 袭击市民、Hall of Factions 闯入案被 Erudite 安全系统拦下。
facts.anchor: There’s a report about attacks on citizens by the factionless.

facts.fact: 报道提到 Abnegation 的「沉默惩罚」（每次六小时以上）后，其他新人全盯着 Caleb；Quinn 追问是否属实，他答体罚他不知、其余基本属实；对 Fell 同样的问题他说「我不知道」，其实心里清楚。
facts.anchor: as he realizes the other initiates are all staring at him
